Museum Installation

CPPS Earthquake Museum

A public earthquake training centre in Switzerland where visitors learn, by playing, what an earthquake is and how to react. The technology behind it: 27 interactive stations across 3 spaces with 30+ touchscreen mini-games, designed with seismologists and university professors; a fleet of 30 kiosk tablets updated remotely; Escape With Wallis, an hour-long escape game through the exhibit; and the reservation and payment platform for schools, companies and public services. The centre also houses Europe's largest earthquake simulator.

30kvisitors / year
27interactive stations
30+touchscreen mini-games

Features

  • 30+ touchscreen mini-games across 3 spaces and 27 stations
  • Fleet of 30 kiosked wall tablets, centrally configured and remotely updated
  • Escape With Wallis: hour-long escape game, 3,000+ sessions completed
  • Reservation and payment platform, 50,000 users a year
  • Designed with seismology experts and university professors
  • Multi-language content
